about: I am a Data Engineering Analyst and AI Automation Engineer with a strong background in SQL development, data integration, reporting, process automation, and enterprise solutions.

Throughout my experience, I have worked with SQL Server, ETL processes, data analysis, reporting solutions, Power BI, Power Automate, Azure DevOps, BMC Control-M, and Microsoft development technologies, designing and supporting solutions that improve data processing, reporting, and business operations.

In addition to my Data Engineering background, I actively work with Generative AI and AI-driven automation. I have designed and developed multiple AI agents using Microsoft Copilot to support technical analysis, SQL development, troubleshooting, requirements understanding, process documentation, and day-to-day engineering activities.

I also use AI and automation technologies to improve development workflows, reduce repetitive work, accelerate problem solving, and create more efficient ways of interacting with technical and business processes.

My background in Systems Analysis, programming, algorithms, databases, and software development allows me to quickly adapt to new technologies and programming languages and apply them to real-world problems.

I am especially interested in opportunities where Data Engineering, automation, and Artificial Intelligence come together to build practical solutions that improve business processes and engineering productivity.
